lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve visible vertical columns on the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a grid-like structure of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition from a light-colored dorsal ridge to a shadowed ventral gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible leading edge and surface of the first dorsal fin contain a cluster of roughly ten small, discrete high-luminance blobs distributed with higher density toward the fin base.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-luminance, elongated white remora is positioned horizontally over the pectoral fin region, creating a distinct contrast anomaly relative to the surrounding dermal pattern.
